techaviv-lendbuzz:lever:3b02409b-70ba-47.descriptionHtml:
Fuel your career with innovation and opportunity! We’re looking for a results-driven Dealership Account Manager in Providence, RI to join our growing field sales team. In this role, you’ll help expand our market reach and build trusted partnerships with dealerships across the region. As a field-based position, you’ll be on-site, visiting dealerships daily—connecting with partners, driving growth, and making an impact where it matters most. The role typically follows a six-day work week, offering hands-on engagement and the chance to truly own your territory. Bring your passion for auto finance, your drive to succeed, and your commitment to delivering exceptional results.
 
***Residence within or near the assigned geographic territory is required.***
  • Prospecting and Business Development: Identify and engage new dealership partners to expand our network, drive growth, and strengthen market presence in the automotive finance sector.
  • Dealer Support and Relationship Management: Provide exceptional service and consultative support to dealer partners through on-site visits to ensure satisfaction, loyalty, and long-term success.
  • Market Analysis: Analyze market trends and competitive insights to identify opportunities and guide strategic business decisions.
  • Brand Promotion: Enhance brand visibility and reputation through targeted outreach, effective communication, and consistent representation of our values and offerings.
  • Minimum of 2 years experience in account management, sales, or business development — ideally within automotive lending, finance, or a related field.
  • A consistent record of professional growth, including at least 2 years in your most recent role.
  • Hands-on experience in auto finance or dealership account management; special finance experience is highly valued.
  • Willingness and ability to maintain a six-day work week with daily in-person visits to dealership partners throughout the territory.

techaviv-tremor-international:ashbyhq:29.descriptionHtml:
Who is Nexxen?
Flexible advertising, unified by data. Nexxen empowers advertisers, agencies, publishers and broadcasters around the world to utilize data and advanced TV in the ways that are most meaningful to them. Our flexible and unified technology stack comprises a demand-side platform (“DSP”) and supply-side platform (“SSP”), with the Nexxen Data Platform at its core.

Why join the Nexxen team?
With a global footprint, you can be part of a team that is transforming advertising through our creative, flexible and unified solutions. Employees hustle, commit and dedicate themselves to pillars that make up the Nexxen Way – the 3Cs - Customer Centric, Curious Mindset, Collaborative with No Ego.

Important Notice from Nexxen: Your Safety Matters

At Nexxen, we care about the well-being of our current and future employees. We are aware of the growing number of online scams and fraudulent job postings, and we urge all job seekers to remain vigilant. Please be advised that Nexxen will never request payment (whether in cash, cryptocurrency, or any other form) as a condition of employment, offer positions that require you to invest in vague or dubious financial schemes, or promote roles that resemble get-rich-quick opportunities. If you receive a suspicious message claiming to be from Nexxen or encounter a questionable job posting associated with our name, please contact us at infosec@nexxen.com to verify its legitimacy. Your trust is important to us. Stay safe and informed.

Nexxen Fraud Alert and Notice: Protect Yourself from Impersonation and Fraudulent Activity

What you'll do

As an Enterprise Sales Director, you will lead all the tactical sales and client management responsibilities of your book of business across our Southeast US region. You’ll be responsible for driving revenue through a combination of first-class account management and proactive selling of our full-stack, end-to-end technology solutions. Nexxen’s platform, consisting of an integrated DSP, DMP and SSP, delivers global reach with across 1 BILLION unique profiles, that is accessible across all channels and devices, supported by advanced measurement capabilities.

In this role, you will drive sales performance, ensure exceptional client satisfaction, and build long-term, trusted relationships with agency and brand direct partners by delivering superior sales execution and client service expertise.

Each day can be different here at Nexxen, but some of the things you can expect to be doing are:

  • Own and execute the Southeast territory strategy, driving new business and establishing Nexxen’s presence across the region

  • Establish and grow senior relationships with agency and brand stakeholders to support long term regional growth

  • Understand client business challenges and identify opportunities to position Nexxen solutions that drive revenue growth

  • Partner cross-functionally with Trading and Account Management teams to deliver client outcomes and drive successful campaign execution

  • Own pipeline management, forecasting, revenue planning, and reporting

  • Lead and manage complex sales cycles involving multiple internal and external stakeholders

This role is currently remote within the Southeast region. Subject to change if Nexxen establishes a local office presence in the future.

What will I bring?

  • 8+ years of experience in AdTech sales, ideally at a DSP, selling to brands and media agencies

  • Proven track record of exceeding revenue targets within AdTech sales environments

  • Established network of relationships with decision-makers at brands and media agencies across the Southeast region

  • A proven approach to solution selling: Positioning and packaging bespoke offerings across Nexxen’s solution set (THIS IS NOT A TRANSACTIONAL MEDIA SALES ROLE)

  • Deep understanding of the AdTech ecosystem (DSP, SSP, DMP, ad networks, ad exchanges, ad servers, and other online advertising technology) and key MarTech ecosystem functions (CDPs and CRM functionality)

  • Willingness to travel within the Southeast region for client meetings and industry events as needed

  • Ability to operate effectively in a highly autonomous, territory-driven role

  • Strong executive presence and communication skills, with the ability to build credibility with Senior/C-level clients

  • Strong team player and ability to succeed in a fast-paced, rapidly changing environment while maintaining high levels of operational rigor, digital acumen, and business excellence

At Nexxen, we value our differences, varied experiences, and collective contributions. We know that not everyone takes the same career path, so if you don’t match this job description perfectly, don’t worry! We would rather see your application than risk missing out on your potential to make an impact.

The specific programs and options available will vary depending on the state, start date, and employment type. Our Talent Acquisition team will be happy to answer any questions you may have.

usv-forerunner:ashbyhq:16660a3f-5cf2-4e7.descriptionHtml:
Hi! We're Forerunner.

We believe that adaptation is a necessity, not a luxury, and communities deserve access to powerful software that helps them plan for the future. The challenge of climate change is complex – it implicates how governments plan, manage capital, and communicate to stakeholders. Forerunner helps government agencies do these things better by empowering them to access, understand, and mobilize local-level data at scale.

About the position:

We're looking for a talented Business Development Representative with 1-3 years of experience to join our company to provide support to our sales teams. Your responsibilities will include:

  • Identify high-potential government customers and execute outbound strategies to connect them to Forerunner

  • Move leads through the funnel, arranging meetings with an Account Executive

  • Develop and lead campaigns from idea-generation through to qualified calls and determine how best to scale them

  • Partner with Account Executives at Forerunner to build strategies and prospect into designated accounts

  • Effectively work through lead list meeting/exceeding SLAs, consistently update activity and contact information within the CRM system and support weekly reporting effort.

In general, the Business Development Representative role may be a good fit if you:

  • Have demonstrable proficiency solving ambiguous problems. You are an analytical individual who enjoys creating structure where there is none, tackling problem solving creatively, and working collaboratively to achieve goals.

  • Have strong verbal and written communication skills. As a Business Development Representative, effective communication is vital. You should articulate ideas clearly in writing and verbally engage prospects to generate interest and meaningful connections.

  • Have an eye for detail. Attention to detail is crucial. You'll manage prospect data and interactions, ensuring accuracy in our CRM system to maintain an organized pipeline.

  • Strong interest in climate adaptation and technology. Your enthusiasm will drive your understanding of our products and enable you to communicate their value effectively to potential clients.

Our team has a lot to offer.

Forerunner is an early stage company with an interdisciplinary team. We are motivated by seemingly intractable problems and work hard to support one another.

  • We're mission-driven. Our mission orients our business strategy and pushes us to work with a sense of urgency. We’re in the weeds -- our entire team spends time engaging with our partners in the field to better understand the real-world problems they face.

  • We're a small team. As a member of our growing team, you will quickly become an invaluable part of our organization and have a meaningful impact on our business and technical direction. We welcome unique perspectives and backgrounds. Your opinion matters and we hope you'll share it.

  • We want you to be happy and healthy. Forerunner offers competitive compensation, health/vision/dental coverage, and commuter benefits. We also have a quarterly wellness reimbursement so that you can have flexibility in defining what “health” means to you.

  • The base pay for this position is $50,000-$80,000 annually with an OTE of $80,000-$110,000. This posting may span more than one career level. Compensation is determined based on a variety of factors, including an individual’s skills, experience and qualifications.

usv-relay-link:ashbyhq:fbfecfe4-f549-4b0.title: Operations Manager - London Sort Centre
usv-relay-link:ashbyhq:fbfecfe4-f549-4b0.descriptionHtml:
Relay is fundamentally reshaping how goods move in an online era. Backed by Europe’s largest-ever logistics Series A ($35M), led by deep-tech investors Plural (whose portfolio spans fusion energy and space exploration), Relay is scaling faster than 99.98% of venture-backed startups. We're assembling the most talent-dense team the logistics industry has ever seen

Relay’s Mission is to free commerce from friction. Today, high delivery costs act as a hidden tax on e-commerce, quietly shaping what can be sold online and limiting who can participate. We envision a world where more goods move more freely between more people, making the online shopping experience seamless and accessible to everyone.

THE TEAM
• ~110 people, more than half in engineering, product and data
• 45+ advanced degrees across computer science, mathematics and operations research
• Thousands of data points captured, calculated, analysed and predicted for every single parcel we handle
• An intellectually vibrant culture of first‑principles thinking, tight feedback loops and relentless experimentation

The Role

Top-of-market salary, with above market equity in one of Europe’s top Series A startups. This role is the pathway to becoming a General Manager of your own Hybrid Sort Centre with up to 1 Million parcels a day capacity.

You will own an entire shift at one of our fulfilment sites; the people, the throughput, the quality, and the continuous improvement of all three. You’ll lead 50–100+ operatives through high-volume, time-pressured operations where minutes matter and small deviations cascade quickly into missed deadlines and customer impact.

Think of it as running a logistics mission that resets every single day and you use the learnings of one shift to improve the next. If you’ve managed large field teams in logistics, distribution, manufacturing, transport, or the military then you already understand the tempo. If you haven’t worked in parcels or sortation before, that’s fine. Some of our best managers hadn’t either.

What matters is how you think and lead.

What You Will Do

  • Run shift operations end-to-end: people deployment, throughput targets, quality standards, and health & safety compliance

  • Lead, motivate, and develop a frontline team of 50–100+ operatives; including onboarding, coaching, and managing performance

  • Use dashboards and KPIs to identify problems early, make decisions quickly, and track whether the changes you make are actually working

  • Build and improve SOPs, controls, and feedback loops that keep your shift running safely and efficiently. You won’t just follow them, but write them

  • Own the end-of-shift handover; what happened, what’s at risk, what the next shift needs to know

  • Collaborate across shifts with engineering, data, and ops leadership to solve problems that cross boundaries

  • Stay calm and decisive during peak periods, outages, and labour gaps - triaging, containing impact, and restoring flow

Who You Are

You don’t need to have worked in parcels, fulfilment, or sortation. What you need is:

  • Proven leadership of large teams (50+) of front line workers in fast-paced, physical operations — logistics, distribution, manufacturing, transport, military, or similar environments where on-time delivery and compliance are non-negotiable

  • Reasoning ability — you think through problems methodically rather than relying on “how we’ve always done it.” When you walk into a new situation, you structure a response rather than freeze

  • Resilience — when things break, you get calmer and more structured, not flustered. You’ve been through operational crises and came out the other side having learned something

  • Metrics obsessed — You don’t need to be a data analyst, but you need to be able to look at a metric and decide what to do about it. You don’t need to design the metric, but you do need to understand, own and act on the metric.

  • Clear, direct communication — you can brief a team of 80 operatives at shift start and then present a problem to senior leadership in the same day

  • Ownership mindset - You want to help build something meaningful, not just complete a shift and move on.

Backgrounds That Translate Well

We’ve seen great Operations Managers come from:

  • Logistics & distribution

  • Manufacturing & production operations

  • Startups with a primary focus on operations

  • Transport & fleet management

  • We support ex-serviceman - particularly NCOs and junior officers who led large teams under operational pressure

  • Aviation operations & air traffic control

  • Any environment where compliance, on-time execution, and managing large frontline teams are the core of the job

If you’re reading this thinking “I’ve never considered sortation but this sounds like what I do and am good at” — that’s exactly who we’re looking for. We are looking for people that will continuously seek improvement and have the bias to action to execute the improvements.

Our hiring process is fast.

  • Initial screen (15 min)

  • Hiring Manager conversation (90 minutes), 45 min will be an onsite interview immediately followed by a 45 min site tour where you shadow an existing shift manager

  • Final interview (45 min) -→ Decision and offer within 48 hours.

Who Thrives at Relay?

  • Aim with Precision: You define problems clearly and measure your impact meticulously.

  • Play to Win: You chase bold bets, tackle the hard stuff, and view constraints as fuel, not friction.

  • 1% Better Every Day: You believe that small, consistent improvements lead to exponential growth. You move quickly, deliver results, and learn from every experience.

  • All In, All the Time: You show up and step up. You take ownership from start to finish and do what it takes to deliver when it counts.

  • People-Powered Greatness: You invest in your teammates. You give and receive feedback with care and candour. You build trust through high standards and shared success.

  • Grow the Whole Pie: You seek out win-win solutions for merchants, couriers, and our customers, because when they thrive, so do we.

    If these resonate, and you combine strong technical fundamentals with entrepreneurial drive, let’s connect.

Relay is an equal-opportunity employer committed to diversity, inclusion, and fostering a workplace where everyone thrives.

xange-skello:lever:54fb7217-8d17-41ae-9c.descriptionHtml:
🌰Skello en bref

Chez Skello, on développe la solution RH de référence pour planifier et manager les équipes de terrain.

En Europe, les équipes de terrain représentent 50 % des travailleurs, mais seulement 20 % des solutions digitales leur sont réellement adressées.

Skello est né pour combler ce manque : une plateforme collaborative et intuitive qui simplifie le quotidien des managers et des employés, en optimisant et en automatisant les tâches clés.

On met les équipes de terrain au cœur de tout ce que l'on fait. Avec des outils intelligents comme notre Assistant Skello et notre smart planner, on répond directement à leurs besoins uniques.

Notre ambition est simple : devenir la solution RH incontournable pour toutes les équipes de terrain en Europe. 🚀

🚀Skello en chiffres
 
• 7 secteurs clés  
• 25 000 entreprises font confiance à Skello aujourd'hui.
• 600 000 employés utilisent Skello chaque jour.
• L'équipe Skello, c'est plus de 400 collaborateurs.
• 3 hubs européens : Paris, Lille et Barcelone

💙 Notre culture d'entreprise

On sait que pour atteindre notre mission, il faut vivre nos valeurs chaque jour : SHIFT.
💡 Set the bar higher everyday
🤝 Have each other’s back
🚀 Imagine tomorrow, start today
👟 Focus on customers first
😄 Take work seriously, not ourselves


🧭 Contexte
 
Chez Skello, la team Product est au coeur de la croissance et de l’innovation. Dès ses débuts, elle a été pensée comme un levier d'impact, avec une forte exigence sur la qualité des livrables et l’alignement business.
 
L'équiope est composée de PM, Product Designers et PMM expérimenté·es, engagé·es et exigeant·es. On se challenge, on teste, on ship. Mais surtout : on est obsédé·es par l’impact concret sur les utilisateurs. Ici, tu travailles avec des gens brillants, dans un environnement où la curiosité, l’humilité et le feedback sont au centre.
 
On cherche aujourd’hui à renforcer cette équipe avec un·e PM talentueux·se, qui a envie de résoudre des problèmes complexes, de livrer de la valeur concrète et de continuer à grandir au contact d’une team ambitieuse et bienveillante.
 
 
🎯 Missions
 
En tant que PM chez Skello, tu prendras en main un périmètre fonctionnel à fort enjeu et contribueras au quotidien à créer un produit utile, simple et performant. Tu seras au cœur de la collaboration avec les équipes design et tech pour faire émerger les meilleures solutions.
- Tu mènes des interviews utilisateurs, analyses data et recherches exploratoires pour comprendre en profondeur les besoins et irritants terrain
- Tu travailles main dans la main avec les designers et développeurs pour définir des solutions simples et impactantes, en gardant toujours l'utilisateur au centre
- Tu pilotes la phase de delivery avec clarté : gestion des sprints, animation des rituels, suivi des développements, QA et documentation
- Tu suis les KPIs d’usage et d’impact, proposes des ajustements et itérations concrètes pour améliorer continuellement le produit
- Tu collabores étroitement avec les équipes Customer Experience, Sales, Marketing et Ops pour assurer l’impact de tes features une fois en production
- Tu contribues à l’amélioration continue de nos outils, de notre process et de notre culture produit
 
 
Qualifications
Ce qu’on attend de toi :
- Solides compétences analytiques et capacité à utiliser des données pour prendre des décisions éclairées
- 3 à 5 ans d’expérience en Product Management dans un environnement tech ou SaaS
- Une très bonne culture produit : discovery, delivery, UX, impact business
- Une aisance avec la data : KPIs, analyses, validation d’hypothèses
- Une vraie capacité à embarquer les autres, à prendre des décisions et à faire avancer les sujets
- Du sérieux sans se prendre au sérieux : exigence, autonomie, esprit d’équipe
 
C’est un plus si :
Tu comprends les contraintes et usages des métiers de terrain (planning, RH, opérations) dans des secteurs comme le retail, la restauration ou les services
Process
 
- Entretien téléphonique avec Paul (Talent Acquisition Manager) (30 min)
- 1er entretien Métier avec Bruno/Lucie - Head of PM - (30 min) en visio
- 2ème entretien Technique avec Bruno/Lucie & l'un de Lead Product - 1h en présentiel
- 3ème entretien Vision avec Ariane (VP Product)

Ce que tu trouveras chez nous 🙌

🍽️ Tickets restaurant Swile : 55% de vos repas quotidiens couverts par Skello.
🏋️‍♂️ Cours de sport collectif : Pour bien commencer la semaine, on se retrouve le lundi soir.
🏖️ Jours de RTT : 8 jours (10 pour nos commerciaux/BDR au forfait heures) en plus de vos congés payés pour compenser les heures sup'.
🚀 Onboarding aux petits oignons : un programme complet dès votre première semaine.
🎉 CSE Happy Pal : Une plateforme avec 20€/mois de subvention pour vos activités sportives et culturelles.
👶 Parentalité inclusive : 5 jours de congés supplémentaires si besoin, un bonus naissance de 175€ via Sidecare, et une mutuelle gratuite pour vos enfants.
🏡 Télétravail possible : Une politique adaptée au rythme de chaque équipe.
🚇 Bureaux centraux : Paris et Lille, au cœur de villes dynamiques, facilement accessibles en transports.

About Zip

Zip is the AI platform for enterprise procurement — built for humans and agents working together. By orchestrating procurement across teams, tools, and suppliers with the help of AI agents, companies can secure the resources they need to innovate faster than ever before.

Your Role

As a member of Zip’s GTM Strategy & Operations team, you’ll be a key partner to Sales, Marketing, and the broader executive team - driving strategic planning, operational execution, and analytical rigor across our revenue engine. This team sits at the intersection of go-to-market execution, company strategy, and systems - giving you a unique seat at the table to shape the trajectory of the business.

You’ll operate as a true business partner and execution arm for our revenue leaders - owning the core rhythms, models, and metrics that power GTM performance.

What You’ll Do

  • Own GTM operations for a business unit: Lead day-to-day operations and long-term planning for one or more sales segments, including territory design, comp plans, sales metrics, reporting, and “whatever it takes.”

  • Act as a strategic thought partner: Be the go-to partner for sales leadership and execs - whether it’s solving complex problems, framing key decisions, or bringing structure to ambiguity.

  • Drive GTM cadence and accountability: Run the operating rhythm - owning pipeline reviews, forecast calls, QBRs, and leadership syncs. You’ll push velocity, track outcomes, and ensure every meeting drives impact.

  • Lead cross-functional execution: Work across Sales, Marketing, CS, Product, and Finance to drive strategic initiatives forward - bringing a GTM perspective to company-wide efforts and ensuring alignment across teams.

  • Build with data: Use SQL, spreadsheets, and BI tools to structure analysis, validate assumptions, and uncover insights that improve GTM execution and drive growth.

  • Own special projects: From compensation design to rep productivity modeling to account segmentation - you’ll own critical, high-impact workstreams that move the business forward.

What We're Looking For

  • 8+ years of experience in sales strategy, revenue operations, consulting, investing, or a similar high-performance environment.

  • Strong analytical and modeling skills - you’re fluent in Excel/Sheets and can write SQL or are willing to learn.

  • Deep understanding of go-to-market motions and SaaS business models, with battle-tested views on comp, funnel metrics, over-assignment, and enrichment.

  • Experience working closely with GTM systems like Salesforce, Outreach, Clari, and Gong.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication - you can structure thinking clearly, write concise memos, and present to executives with confidence.

  • Attention to detail - you go deep on problems, sweat the edge cases, and set the quality bar high.

  • High bias for action - you move fast, think in tradeoffs, and find a way forward when others see blockers.

  • Technically inclined - you’re not afraid of Salesforce Flows, brittle validation rules, or stitching together data across systems.

  • A collaborative mindset - you’re opinionated but open to all perspectives, and you know how to drive alignment across stakeholders.

  • A proven operator - you’ve managed large, ambiguous projects that required both strategic thinking and tactical execution.

The salary range for this role is $170,000 - $230,000. The salary for this position is determined based on a variety of job-related factors that may include location, relevant experience, education, or particular skills and expertise.
